stages.name: Problem Understanding
stages.description: Analyze emergency response telemetry gaps and define payload constraints.

checklist.text: Interview first responders and wildfire teams
Establish maximum payload weight (50 grams)
Determine battery life target (72+ hours)

stages.notes: Target: 50g weight limit, sub-GHz transmission, under $150 bill of materials.

stages.name: Research & Benchmarking
stages.description: Datasheet studies, radio regulations (FCC 915MHz), sensor evaluation.

checklist.text: Compare ESP32-S3 vs nRF52840 vs STM32
Review Bosch BME688 AI gas scanner accuracy
Test SX1262 LoRa range in urban/forest conditions

stages.notes: ESP32-S3 selected due to dual core, FreeRTOS, and vector instructions for TinyML.

stages.name: Ideation & Architecture
stages.description: Brainstorming modular pods, power harvesting, and mesh protocol.

checklist.text: Submit and review Vault ideas
Select venturi intake airflow concept
Draft system block diagram and power architecture

stages.name: Solution Selection & ADRs
stages.description: Formalize Architectural Decision Records (ADRs) for hardware components.

checklist.text: Record Decision #01: ESP32-S3 processor
Record Decision #02: I2C 400kHz sensor bus
Approve BOM and budget allocation

stages.name: System Design & Schematics
stages.description: KiCad schematic capture, power distribution network, pinout allocation.

checklist.text: Complete ESP32-S3 minimum operating circuit
Design 3.3V ultra-low quiescent LDO regulator
Generate bill of materials and check supplier stock

stages.name: Component Sourcing
stages.description: Procure and verify components, inspect pinouts, organize inventory.

checklist.text: Order ESP32-S3 modules and SX1262 boards
Inspect BME688 breakouts under microscope
Log storage bins and prices in Inventory

stages.name: Prototype V1 (Breadboard / Perfboard)
stages.description: Assemble first working circuit, verify basic sensor I2C communication.

checklist.text: Solder jumper headers and power rails
Verify 3.3V rail ripple with oscilloscope
Transmit first mock telemetry packet over LoRa

stages.name: Testing & Validation (Exp Lab)
stages.description: Run formal experiments on sleep current, radio range, and gas response.

checklist.text: Exp #01: Deep sleep current profiling
Exp #02: BME688 heater humidity stress test
Exp #03: RF line of sight packet loss test

stages.notes: Exp #02 identified heater calibration issues; fix applied in firmware v0.4.

stages.name: Prototype V2 (Milled PCB & Enclosure)
stages.description: Compact form-factor assembly with 3D printed aerodynamic enclosure.

checklist.text: Mill 2-layer compact PCB on desktop CNC
3D print PETG venturi nosecone enclosure
Assembly and vibration test on drone mount

stages.name: Integration & Flight Trial
stages.description: Mount payload onto drone and perform simulated gas plume detection run.

checklist.text: Verify magnetic latch and drone vibration dampening
Execute 15-minute autonomous survey flight
Validate live ground-station packet telemetry

stages.name: Final Optimization & Polish
stages.description: Weight trimming, conformal coating for weather resistance, packaging.

checklist.text: Apply silicone conformal coating to PCB
Final weight check (target <= 45g)

stages.name: Documentation & Presentation
stages.description: Complete schematics, bill of materials, demo video, and slide deck.

checklist.text: Generate high-res wiring diagrams and pinout sheets
Record 2-minute live hardware demonstration video
Prepare judges technical slide deck

stages.name: Submission & Live Defense
stages.description: Final project submission to hackathon portal and judging Q&A.

checklist.text: Upload code to GitHub repository with open-source license
Submit final bill of materials and test logs

stages.name: Custom Field Validation & Long-Range Drone Flight

checklist.text: Range test LoRa with directional Yagi antenna
Log gas sensor ppm baseline at 20 knots airspeed

stages.description: Testing LoRa telemetry payload at 5km range and 50m altitude.

activityLogs.description: Clean workspace initialized. Ready for hardware innovation.
